_comment: DRAFT region-lock groups (regionlock branch, 2026-11-03). One unlock item per group, named '<Map>: <Group>'.
Region keys are the ids in apworld/ark_ase/data/explore_areas.json. 'open' = unlocked from the start (unless
start_area is random, see below). 'caves' = one key item per cave, named '<Map>: <Cave> Key'.
Membership rule: a spot is blocked if ANY locked group's region covers it; inside a cave (outline + depth band)
only the cave key counts; ground outside every outline is always open.
